name: delegate
description: Start durable delegated work. Inline ask waits in this turn; process/channel work returns a handle immediately and its settlement arrives as a message. Notify sends once to an actor and settles sent at transport acceptance.

instruction.description: What the worker must do, self-contained.

operation.description: notify = fire-and-forget, ask = expect an answer, assign = accountable work (creates a WorkItem).

acceptanceCriteria.description: assign only: criteria the work must satisfy to complete.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline in milliseconds; settlement arrives by then or as no_response.

scope.description: Worker placement: inline = same-process worker, independent = spawned child process. Provide exactly one of scope or actorId.

actorId.description: Channel contact to ask instead of a worker. Provide exactly one of scope or actorId.

name: await_delegation
description: Re-invoke a durable delegation by id. It returns its settlement when available, or says it is still open until the supplied wait limit.

name: cancel_delegation
description: Cancel open delegated work by id; cancelling settled work returns the existing settlement.

name: converse_open
description: Open a bounded reply window to a known contact. While it is open, the contact's inbound reaches this session directly and sends to the contact ride the window instead of a grant. The window closes on its deadline, its caps, or converse_close.

endpointId.description: Allocated endpoint of that actor the window is pinned to.

timeoutMs.description: How long the window stays open from now.

maxOutbound.description: Outbound message cap inside the window (default 8).

maxInbound.description: Inbound message cap before the treatment demotes to evidence_only (default 32).

name: converse_close
description: Settle an open reply window by id. Closing an already-closed window returns its existing settlement.

name: lease_open
description: Carve a bounded send allocation from an open conversation for a live delegation. The holder may then message that contact directly; the lease dies with the delegation, the conversation, or its own budget.

delegationId.description: Open delegation that will hold the lease.

conversationId.description: Open conversation whose budget is carved.

maxOutbound.description: How many outbound sends the lease may spend from the window.

name: approval_request
description: Open a deadline-bound Owner-approval request for a contact promotion or a cross-channel endpoint merge. Unanswered requests read as refused after the deadline.

name: approval_decide
description: Record the Owner's answer to a pending approval request. Only usable when the Owner has answered in this session; answers past the deadline record the deadline's refusal.

name: contact_promote
description: Register a provisional contact. Requires an approved, unexpired contact_promotion approval naming that contact.

approvalId.description: Approved request that authorizes this act.

name: endpoint_merge
description: Move an endpoint onto another identity (cross-channel merge). Requires an approved, unexpired endpoint_merge approval naming exactly that move.

approvalId.description: Approved request that authorizes this act.

name: person_declare
description: Upsert a Person manifest (identity + platform endpoint bindings). Tier raises above collaborator and any change to the owner Person open a person_mutation approval pinned to this exact manifest's digest; re-run with the approved approvalId to land it.

trustTier.description: Standing trust tier for every bound endpoint.

endpoints.description: Platform identities this Person speaks through.

approvalId.description: Approved person_mutation approval, when the guard requires one.

timeoutMs.description: Answer window for a guard-opened approval request (default 24h).

name: person_remove
description: Remove a Person manifest and its derived identity. Refuses to remove the sole owner.

name: channel_declare
description: Upsert a ChannelInstance declaration. A supplied credential is validated against the provider's schema, sealed into the vault, and referenced — invalid credentials refuse before anything lands. Affected stages bounce immediately.

credential.description: Plaintext credential payload; sealed into the vault, never stored bare.

name: channel_enable
description: Enable a declared channel and bounce its stage. Also re-arms a breaker-paused instance (the manual resume).

name: channel_disable
description: Disable a declared channel and stop its stage.

name: secret_rotate
description: Seal a new credential revision over an existing vault row and bounce every stage referencing it (stop → swap → start).

name: provision_status
description: Read-only: where channel truth comes from (declared store vs env), per-instance mount state including vault_locked and paused_by_breaker, and vault lock state.

name: run_code
description: Run Python on an attached machine; state persists across cells in _scope, so do a whole step in one cell. Inside it, tool.<name>(...) bridges to the tools you hold here, parallel(thunks) runs independent calls concurrently, llm(prompt) asks a budget-capped sub-model, and write_artifact/read_artifact move large text by id.

machineId.description: Which attached machine runs the code.

code.description: Python source. Call host tools inside it as tool.<name>(...) — that is the point: many calls, one round trip.

timeoutMs.description: How long the cell may run before it is stopped.

name: machines
description: List the machines this system is enrolled with: which are attached right now and what each may do. Use it to pick the machineId a run_code cell targets.

name: fs_read
description: Read a file on an attached machine through the flat /machines/<machineId>/<export>/<path> namespace. Use fs_list to discover what an export holds. Large files come back truncated, and say so.

path.description: A path in the machine namespace: /machines/<machineId>/<export>/<path inside it>.

limit.description: How many bytes to read; capped at 262144.

name: fs_list
description: List a directory on an attached machine: /machines/<machineId>/<export> is the export root. Each line is kind, name, and size for files.

path.description: A path in the machine namespace: /machines/<machineId>/<export>/<path inside it>.

name: fs_stat
description: What a path on an attached machine IS — file, directory, symlink, or other — with its size and last modification time.

path.description: A path in the machine namespace: /machines/<machineId>/<export>/<path inside it>.

name: memory
description: Curate durable memory: add, replace, or remove an entry in the system or owner store. What memory holds is already in your context under # Memory — there is no read. Budgets are hard: when a store is full, curate instead of appending. Writes render from the NEXT session, not this one.

store.description: system = durable operating notes; owner = the Owner's profile.

content.description: The entry text (add and replace only).

name: work_items
description: Inspect commissioned WorkItems: status, acceptance criteria (with ids), recorded evidence, and the attempt outcome. Pass workItemId for one item's detail; omit it to list everything.

workItemId.description: Inspect one WorkItem; omit to list all.

name: complete_work
description: Judge a WorkItem's acceptance criteria for completion admission. Only verified judgments (with the predicate you checked and the evidence ids consumed) admit; asserted or refuted judgments record a durable block and refuse.

items.description: One judgment per criterion. Only verified admits.

name: llm
description: Ask a sub-model a one-shot, stateless question and get its text back. Built for semantic map/reduce over data already inside a cell: summarize, classify, extract, or rank what the code fetched, one prompt per call — it remembers nothing between calls.

prompt.description: The complete instruction for the sub-model call.

name: write_artifact
description: Store text too large to keep quoting in the conversation — a cell's fetched dataset, a long report — under the current session. Returns the artifact id; the content is never echoed back.

name.description: A short title for the artifact.

name: read_artifact
description: Read back the full content of an artifact stored by write_artifact, by its id.
